newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco plans tender for $230 mln highway project.
newsitem.headline: Morocco plans tender for $230 mln highway project.

text.p: Morocco plans to launch an international tender for studies on investing $230 million in a 560 km highway project in the country's northern areas, a Moroccan official said on Thursday.
The tender is open to foreign bidders, and will be launched next week, an official at the ministry of public works said.
The project will link Tangier to the tourist city of Saaidia, both located on the Mediterranean coastline, he said.
"The study concerns Tangier-Saaidia highway project...The investment is estimated at 2.0 billion dirhams ($229.2 million)," the official said.
Last year, Moroccan government launched a huge scheme for infrastructure projects aimed at building more than 10,000 kms of roads, including a motorway linking Rabat to Tangier, by end 1999.
